svg.title: Value Stream Mapping
svg.desc: Value Stream Mapping. Draw how a change travels from idea to customer, compare the time spent working with the time spent waiting, and remove the biggest wait. Step 1, Nobody sees the whole flow: Each team says its own step is fast, yet DLV-214 takes 22.5 days to reach customers: 2.5 are work. Step 2, Map the current state: A workshop walks DLV-214 through every step: 20 of its 22.5 days are waiting; activity ratio 11%. Step 3, Design the future state: Future state: daily triage, CI policy checks, self-service envs, peer review: 4 days, then re-map. Step 4, Pitfalls and limits: Pitfalls: mapping the wiki, a map filed away, the wrong step, new tools, too much detail.

g.text: Each team says its own step is fast, yet DLV-214 takes 22.5 days to reach customers: 2.5 are work.
A workshop walks DLV-214 through every step: 20 of its 22.5 days are waiting; activity ratio 11%.

Pitfalls: mapping the wiki, a map filed away, the wrong step, new tools, too much detail.
